Investing in community means investing for the long term. Through a 10-year, $3.85-million naming-rights partnership, Cameco Centre will be a place where people come together for entertainment, culture, sports and business, while supporting a vibrant Saskatoon economy. We’re proud to deepen our long-standing commitment to Saskatoon and continue investing in the communities where we live and work.
